title: Grid desktop auth options (AuthOptions)
description: Schema for the Grid desktop auth settings file (config/grid.auth.config.json). Mirrors core/features/users/auth/AuthOptions.cs. Contains NO secrets — the desktop is a public OAuth client.

baseUrl.description: AUTH authority origin, e.g. https://signin.grid.app (no trailing slash).

clientId.description: Public client id registered in the AUTH deployment publicClients[].

loopbackPort.description: Port whose http://127.0.0.1:PORT origin must also be present in the AUTH deployment's allowedOrigins (magic email links land here).

loopbackPath.description: Native callback path; must match the AUTH public client loopback path.

presentationFallback.description: Order used only when AUTH discovery is unreachable.
